title: Proyecto Portal Mercado de Energía – Proyecto CIER 19
objectives: General objective: Expand knowledge and availability of information on Latin American energy markets through a web portal that enables tracking of market status, evolution and key parameters, increasing the visibility of electricity markets in Latin America and serving as a practical tool for stakeholders interested in relevant data, market designs, and key institutions per country. Specific objectives: (1) Study energy market models in South America, Central America, Iberian MIBEL, PJM-USA, NORDPOOL, Australia, UK, and Germany; (2) Determine fixed and variable information for each market; (3) Propose a framework for value-added information analysis; (4) Present a scheme to display information and implement it on the CIER website, with a conclusions and recommendations document; (5) Propose mechanisms for portal administration and updating.

feasibility_assessment.assessment: Challenging but feasible with an adequately sized and experienced team
feasibility_assessment.rationale: The 4-month (approx. 120-day) timeline is tight given the breadth of scope: researching 15+ international energy market models across 17 LAC countries and 6 international reference markets, designing and building a multilingual (ES/EN/PT) web portal with dynamic and static content, user access control (LDAP), social media integration (LinkedIn, Facebook), RSS, data export to Excel, and mobile responsiveness. Feasibility depends critically on: (a) CIER delivering the market information inventory on time at project start, (b) GT O&AM representatives being promptly available for iterative validation of market parameters, and (c) the 6-member team executing research and development workstreams with minimal rework between deliverables. The post-launch accompaniment period (2 months) defined in the original terms of reference is excluded from this timeline as it extends beyond the contractual 120-day boundary.

budget: Not specified in the document. The contract value is to be proposed by the consultant as a global fixed price in USD, with no price adjustment clauses. International travel (economy class airfare) is reimbursable by CIER upon invoice presentation. Per diem rates (accommodation, meals, ground transport, taxes) follow the CIER in-force project table. A 10% retention guarantee is withheld from each payment installment and released upon final report approval by CIER (within 3 weeks of definitive version receipt). Payment schedule: 20% advance (1 week after contract signing), 20% after 1st partial report acceptance, 20% after 2nd partial report acceptance, 40% after final report approval.

deliverables.deliverable_name: Final Report – Fully Operational Portal + Documentation
